questions.stem: A Brightwater Cosmetics, a mid-sized firm business in Hillcrest holds a high market share in a slow-growing, mature market and generates steady cash. What is it called in the growth-share matrix?
questions.explanation: A cash cow has high market share in a low-growth market, so it needs little investment and generates cash that can fund other businesses. A star also has high share but in a high-growth market, a question mark has low share in high growth, and a dog has low share in low growth. The mature, high-share position is the classic cash cow.
questions.hint: High share in a slow market produces steady cash.
questions.learningObjective: classify businesses in a portfolio matrix

options.misconception: assumes high share alone defines a star
confuses a mature market with a high-growth one
mistakes a high-share business for a weak one
